rc5_blockers.effect: generate_fill_reports sends the prefixed AccountId as the execution filter's account code, so TWS rejects the fill query with error 321 and startup reconciliation gets no historical fills.
rc5_blockers.upstream_fix: Listed as covered by open PR #5041; in no release.

rc5_blockers.path: restart recovery: working orders from a previous session
rc5_blockers.reported_against: 2.0.0rc6.dev20260921; traced on 2.0.0rc5 in the issue thread
rc5_blockers.effect: An IB PreSubmitted order reconciles as an unhandled SUBMITTED external order, and every later update for it fails with 'Trader ID not found', so the node cannot manage or cancel working orders it finds after a restart.
rc5_blockers.upstream_fix: Listed as covered by open PR #5041; in no release.

rc5_blockers.path: reconciliation: execution queries and external fills
rc5_blockers.effect: reqExecutions replies are replayed as live fills, fills for orders the node did not place become refused reduce-only orders, and the position check waits on them.
rc5_blockers.upstream_fix: Listed as covered by open PR #5041; in no release.

rc5_blockers.reported_against: 2.0.0rc4; the fail-open branch is at crates/risk/src/engine/mod.rs:1218-1234 at tag v2.0.0rc5
rc5_blockers.effect: For a broker-routed SMART instrument the account registered under venue IB is not found, so every account-scoped pre-trade check (max_notional_per_order, free balance, cumulative notional) is skipped with only a debug log.
rc5_blockers.upstream_fix: Closed 2026-09-25T11:03:11Z by develop commit ed6fc8bf47fd37dda97d63b9b2df160719ee2bac ('Apply pre-trade risk to the destination execution account'), which is in no release; PR #5041 also lists it as covered.

rc5_reclassified_reports.reported_effect: The execution client venue IB never matches the SMART instrument venue, so every stock order is denied locally.
rc5_reclassified_reports.basis: Source reading, not an rc5 order observation: at tag v2.0.0rc5 (1b0a49d2) crates/execution/src/engine/mod.rs:2222 denies an order only when client.handles_order_venue(order_venue) is false, and the IB execution client overrides it to return true (crates/adapters/interactive_brokers/src/execution/core.rs:491-496; #4129, merged 2026-05-25, after v1.227.0 of 2026-05-18). An rc5 stock-order probe is the named overturn comparison.

27 local Alpaca lifecycle tests cover bounded ambiguous submit, duplicate/restart, partial/cancel, stale/clock/risk, request budget, ownership and kill failures. Actual paper execution observed full fills and completed-trial recovery; native in-flight (ambiguous-submit) fault behaviour remains unqualified, while native definitive-rejection and repeat-cancel behaviour are qualified by the 2026-09-24 receipt. Native fault receipt 2026-09-24 (blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/native-faults/receipt.json, native_faults_passed on Alpaca paper from the WSL2 workstation): resting submit and cancel, a repeat cancel whose DELETE was answered 204, and a documented sub-penny submit refused with 422 then a 404 lookup, cleanup flat. Gate native-fault-behaviour established 2026-09-24 by a dated flip commit after an independent alpaca-py observation (blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/native-faults/evidence/independent-observation-20260924.json: c01 canceled with 0 filled, no order for c04, 0 open orders and positions, matching the receipt). Only the definitive-rejection class (one sub-penny 422) was exercised as a native fault; ambiguous submits, timeouts, 429/5xx and partial fills remain synthetic or offline-only. C05's DELETE was answered 204, so the engine's handling of a 422 cancel refusal remains offline-tested only; the C04 422 is one paper-endpoint observation, not live evidence; IBKR fault behaviour is not covered.
